title: BSC offline research stage activation
objective: Apply the Owner decision to activate BSC offline-local-research only. Update the constitutional, Owner-decision, Harness config, and ledger records to permit BSC source inventory, master cleaning, candidate screening, local chain verification, and historical replay. Solana remains the only Live/production delivery chain. BSC network collection, Live providers, resident listeners, GMGN automation, real trades, and production database writes remain prohibited. Robinhood remains BLOCKED_STAGE. This task may execute only after the governance PR that registers it is Owner-merged and HARNESS-DOCTOR-FORBIDDEN-PATH-RULE-REPAIR-001-AUDIT-001 is GREEN; BSC Source Inventory becomes READY only after this task receives an independent GREEN audit and its implementation PR is Owner-merged with a merge commit.
forbidden_actions: Do not execute real trades, sign transactions, broadcast transactions, or connect a trading wallet.
Do not read seed phrases, private keys, browser cookies, login sessions, DPAPI material, or trading API keys.
Do not automate a logged-in GMGN page; only consume user-provided offline exports from the private root.
Do not commit wallet addresses, transaction hashes, raw GMGN exports, chainfm_out contents, or private manifests containing raw records.
Do not treat null, unknown, or missing values as zero.
Do not create a cross-chain global wallet score or assume SOL and BSC addresses identify the same entity.
Do not squash, rebase, rewrite pushed history, push to main, or merge a PR.
Do not activate BSC Live, production, network collection, Live providers, resident monitoring, GMGN automation, real trading, or production database writes.
Do not activate Robinhood or alter its BLOCKED_STAGE state.
Do not change product source, package scripts, provider configuration, or unrelated task specifications.
Do not mark BSC Source Inventory READY before the independent activation audit is GREEN and the Owner merge-commits this activation PR.
